# rustinion_group_notifications (Resource)

Manages a group's Notifications setting: "normal" (the organization's routing and the group's alert tuning decide), "digest_only" (nothing is ever pushed for the group's devices - no ntfy/alert webhook, PagerDuty, notification channels or escalation policies - for any reason or severity, emergencies included; findings are still recorded and listed in the email digest; use it for test devices) or "silent" (not emailed either). Destroying this resource puts "normal" back.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group this setting belongs to.

### Optional

- `mode` (String) `normal`, `digest_only` or `silent`. Default `normal`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
